shared.image: Cloud Build steps use name for the image and args or script for the command; wire the assigned entry point.
shared.order: Assign IDs and waitFor required predecessors’ successful completion, not merely textual order.
shared.fatal: No allowFailure or allowed failing exit codes for required gates; rejected Python gates exit unsuccessfully.
shared.assert: Assert valid, boundary and failure predicates; false predicates raise AssertionError in ordinary non-optimized execution.
shared.yaml: With declared PyYAML, import yaml; yaml.safe_dump(config, file_handle), then yaml.safe_load(file_handle). Inspect required resolved fields before runtime submission. Safe loading accepts standard tags, not arbitrary Python constructors.
shared.commit: Use the configured commit trigger and branch filter; inspect stage results and resolved inputs for accepted/rejected fixtures.
shared.event: Use configured Pub/Sub payload bindings and filters; inspect stage results and resolved inputs for accepted/rejected fixtures.

dataset_quality_gate.f1: Validate before training; unexpected/missing features or invalid values should stop the affected execution.
dataset_quality_gate.f2: Name every required check and aggregate explicit pass/fail under the supplied gate policy.
dataset_quality_gate.f3: Raise or return declared failure on required rejection; do not invoke training.
dataset_quality_gate.f4: Retain snapshot and failed checks so repaired data can meet the same requirements.

model_behavior_tests.f1: Test packaged fitted preprocessing and model through the inference prediction path.
model_behavior_tests.f2: Check each fixture’s row count, feature/target correspondence and output shape before values.
model_behavior_tests.f3: Compare numerical output with np.testing.assert_allclose at explicitly declared tolerances.
model_behavior_tests.f4: Exercise malformed/boundary fixtures; require explicit rejection where the contract forbids them.

model_release_quality_gate.f1: Compare candidate with accepted reference and predeclared requirements before promotion.
model_release_quality_gate.f2: Evaluate every supplied acceptance predicate; identify failures on rejection.
model_release_quality_gate.f3: Calculate validation expected error cost using fixed deployment probabilities/costs; include fixed latency/operating limits.
model_release_quality_gate.f4: Failed or incomplete required gates block promotion.
model_release_quality_gate.f5: FPR = FP/(FP+TN); FNR = FN/(FN+TP). Empty actual-class groups give undefined rates.
model_release_quality_gate.f6: With zero correct-prediction cost, expected cost = P(Y=0) × FPR × cost_FP + P(Y=1) × FNR × cost_FN.
model_release_quality_gate.f7: Protected test observations must not fit preprocessing, select models or tune settings; that leaks information.

pipeline_artifact_dependencies.f1: Explicit component input/output artifacts support reuse across experiment and production environments.
pipeline_artifact_dependencies.f2: Record consumed identities, execution parameters and produced identity per stage; filenames alone cannot join outputs.
pipeline_artifact_dependencies.f3: Use a dependency dictionary; verify every required upstream identity against its downstream reference.
pipeline_artifact_dependencies.f4: Require relevant dataset/model validation before dependent execution.
pipeline_artifact_dependencies.f10: Bind consumer args/substitutions to upstream-produced immutable identity; verify actual resolved inputs, not just order.

staged_ml_promotion.f1: Read approved registry name/version and run/artifact link before authorization.
staged_ml_promotion.f2: Continuous delivery checks test-environment compatibility, then model validation before production.
staged_ml_promotion.f3: Preserve exact-artifact validation, including offline requirements and supplied staged evidence.
staged_ml_promotion.f4: Stay within permitted identity/approval scope; record accountable authorization without changing policy.
staged_ml_promotion.f5: Record approval, registry version, artifact identity and per-stage gates.
staged_ml_promotion.f10: Use approved availableSecrets.secretManager version references and step-scoped secretEnv, never literal secret values.
staged_ml_promotion.f11: Use authorized build/step identity; retain separate promotion authorization.
staged_ml_promotion.f12: Check captured output for non-disclosure; never echo or serialize runtime credentials.
staged_ml_promotion.f13: Edit and parse existing staging/production YAML: production requires staging quality and authorization for the identical artifact. Verify unauthorized production does not execute.

pipeline_failure_recovery.f1: Identify failed stage/affected artifacts; preserve completed required-stage identities.
pipeline_failure_recovery.f2: Catch declared recoverable error with try/except; record it and apply only supplied recovery action, never silent success.
pipeline_failure_recovery.f3: Rerun affected required quality checks after repair; stop on failure, never bypass gates.
pipeline_failure_recovery.f4: Reuse upstream artifacts only with valid recorded identity and required validation for the resumed stage.
pipeline_failure_recovery.f9: Distinguish injected recoverable exceptions from unrelated failures; retry at the verified boundary and inspect retry/later-gate execution.
pipeline_failure_recovery.f11: Reconcile declared named uploads: blob.exists(), blob.reload(), generation-bound bytes, expected hash and required validation. Skip only verified completion. Create missing output with blob.upload_from_filename(path, if_generation_match=0). On 412, re-read/verify, never overwrite. Conflict or failed validation stops recovery.
pipeline_failure_recovery.f12: Inject failure after one upload; assert retained generation/hash, only missing uploads complete, retry/later gates execute, and invalid existing output fails. Repeat recovery: no extra uploads/generations, required validation still enforced.

deployed_model_lineage_audit.f1: Trace served artifact to training, resolved configuration, code revision and dataset snapshot.
deployed_model_lineage_audit.f2: Resolve deployed registry version, artifact source and run link.
deployed_model_lineage_audit.f3: Retrieve the run; compare dataset/configuration/artifact evidence with deployment and approval.
deployed_model_lineage_audit.f4: Check identity links pairwise; flag missing/mismatched links, never infer provenance from names.
deployed_model_lineage_audit.f6: Download registry’s exact recorded artifact generation; verify content identity against lineage.
deployed_model_lineage_audit.f7: Inspect local revision with git rev-parse --verify REVISION and git show REVISION; confirm the commit exists, not just its string.
